headline: A 2020 executive order on changing how the federal government evaluates and hires job candidates.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs changes to how federal agencies assess and hire people who apply for government jobs. The title points to updating and reforming those methods. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People applying for federal government jobs
who_it_affects.how: The way their qualifications are judged during hiring may change.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their hiring staff
who_it_affects.how: They may need to update the methods they use to assess and select job candidates.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 26, 2020; the title alone does not give an effective date or deadlines.
